findings.evidenceJa: 構成材質、補強
findings.governingReading: Reinforce the constituent material
findings.explanation: The incantation’s material-composition step becomes an ungrammatical generic noun.

findings.evidenceJa: 成功率一桁
findings.governingReading: a success rate in the single digits
findings.explanation: A single-digit percentage becomes the nonsensical “.01 digits,” radically changing Shirou’s prior success rate.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつの双剣を投影できたから
findings.governingReading: because I was able to project his twin swords
findings.explanation: The English makes the swords Archer’s projections instead of saying that Shirou projected Archer’s paired blades.

findings.evidenceJa: 強化と似て非なるもの
findings.governingReading: something similar to Strengthening, yet fundamentally distinct from it
findings.explanation: A contrast between outward similarity and real difference becomes the opaque claim “falsely similar.”

findings.evidenceJa: 同調開始
findings.governingReading: synchronization start
findings.explanation: 同調 is misread as emotional sympathy inside a technical contrast with Projection Start.

findings.highlight: Not trace on (sympathy start), but trace on (projection start).
findings.evidenceJa: 同調開始ではなく投影開始
findings.governingReading: Not “Synchronization Start,” but “Projection Start”—both read aloud as “Trace On.”
findings.explanation: The English exposes the ruby relation as clumsy parenthetical alternatives and mistranslates one written layer.

findings.highlight: if it still works on me
findings.evidenceJa: 自分自身に働きかける意味さえ同じなら
findings.governingReading: so long as its meaning—acting upon myself—remains the same
findings.explanation: The condition concerns the incantation’s meaning and target; the English substitutes whether the spell remains effective.

findings.highlight: I remove the nerve inside my spine
findings.evidenceJa: 背骨に抉り込んだ感覚を外す
findings.governingReading: I disengage the sensation gouged into my spine
findings.explanation: Shirou stops the induced sensation; the English says he physically removes a nerve.

findings.evidenceJa: 堅い緊張から解けていく
findings.governingReading: my body gradually loosens from its rigid tension
findings.explanation: An intransitive Japanese-shaped construction makes tension the escaping subject and blurs the gradual bodily release.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはまったくです、なんて珍しく軽口を言って
findings.governingReading: Saber unusually jokes, “Quite,”
findings.explanation: Saber’s rare participation in Shirou’s light teasing is reduced to neutral agreement.

findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の教え
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu’s teaching, with his name read affectionately as “Dad”
findings.explanation: The name-and-ruby layering that joins Kiritsugu’s identity to Shirou’s familial address disappears.

findings.highlight: the magus’s way, or his knowledge
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての知識も在り方も
findings.governingReading: knowledge and a way of being as a magus
findings.explanation: The English makes the knowledge belong to an unspecified magus and changes paired aspects into alternatives.

findings.evidenceJa: どうも冴えなかった
findings.governingReading: never seemed particularly sharp or impressive
findings.explanation: A judgment about Kiritsugu’s generally unimpressive air becomes physical or practical clumsiness.

findings.evidenceJa: 楽しむ時は思いっきり楽しむ
findings.governingReading: when it was time to have fun, enjoy it with all your heart
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s maxim about wholehearted conduct is reduced to enjoying preferred things.

findings.evidenceJa: 僕は魔法使いなんだ
findings.governingReading: he said, “I’m a magic-user”
findings.explanation: The ordinary, child-facing self-description and its contrast with 魔術師 are replaced by a different fantasy title.

findings.highlight: might have been the best time of my life
findings.evidenceJa: 純粋に楽しい時間だったのかもしれない
findings.governingReading: may have been a time of pure happiness for me
findings.explanation: The English changes a tentative characterization of the period’s emotional quality into a superlative life ranking.

findings.evidenceJa: 子供っぽい
findings.governingReading: childlike
findings.explanation: Shirou’s fond description of Kiritsugu becomes a flat character defect.

findings.evidenceJa: 子供のような人物
findings.governingReading: a childlike person
findings.explanation: Saber’s parallel, affectionate characterization of her own magus is recast as condemnation.

findings.evidenceJa: とんでもない老人
findings.governingReading: an outrageous old man
findings.explanation: A comic evaluation of the old man’s behavior is mistaken for extreme age.

findings.evidenceJa: 親愛も感じていました
findings.governingReading: felt affection for him
findings.explanation: Saber’s stated fondness is strengthened into the less bounded claim that she loved him.

findings.evidenceJa: もう少しまともな時代
findings.governingReading: a somewhat more sensible or orderly age
findings.explanation: Saber’s dry claim about a less chaotic era becomes an unrestricted moral claim that the age would be better.

findings.evidenceJa: 呆れているのか、笑っているのか
findings.governingReading: Is she exasperated, or smiling?
findings.explanation: Saber’s mixed exasperation and amusement becomes shock or cognitive arrest.

findings.highlight: Saber jumps up as if to protect me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を守るように身を翻すセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber wheels around to shield me
findings.explanation: The specific defensive turn that places Saber between Shirou and Archer becomes a generic upward movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺を斬りつけた敵
findings.governingReading: the enemy who slashed at me
findings.explanation: The blade-specific attack grounding Saber’s response is generalized into “assaulted.”

findings.highlight: if you are to follow your Master’s order
findings.evidenceJa: 己が主の命を守るのなら
findings.governingReading: if you mean to protect your own Master’s life
findings.explanation: Saber’s warning invokes Rin’s life; the English substitutes obedience to an order.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつにその気はない
findings.governingReading: he has no intention of fighting
findings.explanation: Shirou reads Archer’s present intent; the English frames him as personally unwilling.

findings.evidenceJa: 天敵とか仇敵とか
findings.governingReading: the category of a natural enemy or sworn foe
findings.explanation: One of Shirou’s two escalating categories for Archer disappears.

findings.highlight: as if needles are picking at it
findings.evidenceJa: 鍼を刺されたような熱
findings.governingReading: a heat like an acupuncture needle being inserted
findings.explanation: A singular, precise invasive sensation becomes plural needles vaguely “picking” at the body.

findings.highlight: whose nerves are his Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 通常の神経そのものが回路になっている
findings.governingReading: whose ordinary nerves themselves become circuits
findings.explanation: The exceptional physiology is reduced to an awkward singular possessive, losing both “ordinary” and the nerves’ conversion into circuits.

findings.highlight: a circuit you have not used before
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで在ったというのに使われていなかった回路
findings.governingReading: a circuit that had existed all along but had never been used
findings.explanation: The crucial correction—that Shirou’s circuit preexisted rather than being newly made—is omitted.

findings.highlight: The needles poke my back again
findings.evidenceJa: もう一度、背中に鍼が刺さる
findings.governingReading: Once more, an acupuncture needle pierces my back
findings.explanation: A repeated singular needle-like insertion becomes plural external poking.

findings.highlight: I feel a definite thumping from my numb body
findings.evidenceJa: どくどくと脈打つ確かな鼓動を聞き届ける
findings.governingReading: I register the unmistakable, pounding pulse from the half of my body that had been insensible all day
findings.explanation: The first concrete return of sensation loses the pulse, its pounding rhythm, and the all-day duration.

findings.evidenceJa: 体が動く頃には
findings.governingReading: by the time your body can move again
findings.explanation: Archer predicts the point when Shirou can move, not complete healing.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の刀
findings.governingReading: my blade
findings.explanation: Archer refers to one blade; the English changes it to plural swords.

findings.evidenceJa: 新しい魔術
findings.governingReading: a new form of magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category 魔術 is flattened into “magic” during Archer’s explanation.

findings.highlight: Are you going to ask Saber to fight me?
findings.evidenceJa: いつぞやの続きでもするつもりか
findings.governingReading: Do you mean to beg Saber to continue our fight from before?
findings.explanation: Archer’s taunt about Shirou pleading for a rematch loses both the prior duel and its continuation.

findings.evidenceJa: 脳裏に棲みついた不安
findings.governingReading: the unease that has lodged in my mind
findings.explanation: The psychological image is rendered as awkward literal anatomy.

findings.evidenceJa: 我慢ならなかった
findings.governingReading: was more than I could bear
findings.explanation: Shirou’s overwhelming inability to endure Archer’s answer becomes a casual coarse complaint.

findings.highlight: You claim not to have any ideals
findings.evidenceJa: 理想を抱くなと言うおまえ
findings.governingReading: you, who tell me not to embrace an ideal
findings.explanation: Shirou challenges Archer’s injunction; the English instead says Archer claims to possess no ideals himself.

findings.evidenceJa: 大義
findings.governingReading: great causes
findings.explanation: Archer dismisses public causes; the English substitutes justice itself, changing the target of his list.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな不確かな意義など偽物だ
findings.governingReading: such uncertain grounds for meaning are false
findings.explanation: Archer calls those grounds counterfeit; the English changes falsity into lack of utility or meaning.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣を執るのは
findings.governingReading: I take up the sword
findings.explanation: Archer’s concrete image of taking up a sword is generalized into fighting.

findings.highlight: the resulting crime and punishment are all yours
findings.evidenceJa: その罪も罰も全て自分が生み出したもの
findings.governingReading: both the crime and punishment are things you yourself have produced
findings.explanation: The argument’s emphasis on personal creation and causation is reduced to ownership of resulting consequences.

findings.highlight: The ideal requires that you be burdened with them
findings.evidenceJa: 背負う事すら理想の内だ
findings.governingReading: even bearing them is encompassed within the ideal
findings.explanation: Inclusion within the ideal becomes an externally imposed requirement and passive burdening.

findings.highlight: At the very least, that is the case for you, Emiya Shirou. Isn’t that right?
findings.evidenceJa: 少なくともおまえにとってはそうだろう、衛宮士郎
findings.governingReading: At least for you, that is so, Emiya Shirou.
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a confirmation question where Archer makes a pointed declarative judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: 人を叶える
findings.governingReading: brings a person to fulfillment
findings.explanation: The unusual verb links fulfillment to the person themself; “saves” collapses it into the salvation term Archer is qualifying.

findings.evidenceJa: 本人の意思と結果
findings.governingReading: the person’s own will and its result
findings.explanation: The result of personal will becomes actions, altering Archer’s stated condition for fulfillment.

findings.evidenceJa: 金貨と同じ
findings.governingReading: like a gold coin
findings.explanation: The concrete singular coin that passes from hand to hand is generalized into abstract money.

findings.evidenceJa: 死ぬまで繰り返す
findings.governingReading: repeat it until the day you die
findings.explanation: Archer predicts a compulsive recurring pattern; the English changes it into continued pursuit of one ideal.

findings.evidenceJa: 偽りのような人生
findings.governingReading: a life like a falsehood
findings.explanation: Archer’s simile is promoted into a direct declaration that Shirou’s life is false.

findings.highlight: He turns his red back to us and leaves
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い背中が遠ざかっていく
findings.governingReading: the red-clad back recedes
findings.explanation: A static visual of Archer already moving away becomes a newly initiated turn and departure.

findings.evidenceJa: 影が落ちる
findings.governingReading: A shadow falls
findings.explanation: A concrete shadow over the shed scene becomes the temporal idiom of nightfall.

findings.evidenceJa: 土蔵に残された俺たちは
findings.governingReading: We, left behind in the shed
findings.explanation: The final tableau omits that Shirou and Saber have been left together inside the shed.
